title: The Record Utility Type knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is Record<Key, Value> most useful for?
options: Guaranteeing that external input has been validated.
Describing an object mapping a set of keys to values of a consistent type.
Changing a type into a database table at runtime.
questions.answer_key: Describing an object mapping a set of keys to values of a consistent type.
questions.explanation: Record creates a mapped object type; runtime contents still depend on the data and checks.

questions.explanation: The supplied syllabus explicitly includes “Mapping keys to value types”; connect it to a concrete example and verify the behavior relevant to this lesson.
